claims.evidence: Witness only confirms 'Nikon' branding on body; no model number, badge, or top-plate text is legible in the single photo.
Lens barrel text/markings are noted as not clearly legible; focal length and aperture cannot be confirmed from the photo.
No shots of LCD screen, body back/top, sensor, or lens glass are available to assess cosmetic or functional condition.

risks.risk: True camera model may not be a D810 (could be a lower-value Nikon body)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the top plate/model badge or the model name stamped near the lens mount
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/base Nikon DSLR body, not as D810

risks.risk: Lens may not be a genuine 24-70mm or could be a kit lens of lesser value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens barrel showing brand, focal length, and aperture markings
risks.if_unproven: priced as unspecified generic zoom lens

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy prior use not visible externally
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data app

risks.risk: Functional defects in autofocus, dials, buttons, or electronics
risks.proof: Short video showing camera powering on, lens autofocusing, and dials/buttons being operated

risks.risk: Missing standard accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, box)
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body and lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Sensor dust, scratches, or screen damage not visible
risks.proof: Photo of LCD screen and a lens-off shot of the sensor/mirror box
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wear or sensor issues

proof_requests: Clear photo of the top plate and model badge/number
Close-up of the lens barrel markings (brand, focal length, aperture)
Screenshot of shutter count or camera menu info screen
Short video of power-on, autofocus, and dial/button operation
Photo of all included accessories together (battery, charger, strap, memory card, box)
Photo of the LCD screen and sensor with lens removed
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nikon DSLR with a zoom lens, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified base Nikon body, pending proof of the claimed D810 model and 24-70mm lens.
